note: Captured from the public Japanese Editor without feature-flag queries. SB3 files and project folders were handed to the real file and directory pickers (OPFS handles, or a real folder dropped through CDP for Git); no UI text was altered. Sample projects (ネコ/ボール, Ball Demo.sb3, ネコのさんぽ) and personal data are fictional. Headless Chromium does not show the 「…」 debug button or the アドオン palette category, so those are absent from the shots. Git images use a local repository with origin set to kubohiroya/turbowarp-kamishibai-app; PR images read public PR #219 without signing in.

english.note: Images for the English guide pages (index.en.html), taken in the same states as the Japanese images with English sample names (Cat/Ball, speed, score, scores, start, game over; Git fixture "Cat Walk" with branch 12-cat-walk). The English pages reuse the Japanese current-git-create-pr.png, current-git-merge-ready.png (need a GitHub connection), asset-preview-development.png (Kamishibai development build), local-media-panes.png (local integration build) and github-files-changed.png (GitHub screen), with captions saying so. In English mode the block form still shows the Japanese heading 設定, and the messages panel shows Japanese corner brackets around message names; these are rendered as the editor shows them.
